title: Independent verification: R480 private-center erasure and 40 CLEAR/COPY omissions (no new kappa)
body:
**Independent finite verification. No new kappa.** The intact PR1094-retained R480 scalar word passes on **all 712 inputs and outputs**, including eight arbitrary private centers. Its complete private-center CLEAR/COPY omission atlas contains **40 sites: eight scalar-redundant operations and 32 exact rank-one defects**.

Eight backward initial-clear omissions are invisible on every ordinary input column, including private output rows. With `C0=1` and every other input zero, deleting backward event **12551** produces `L0=-1` and 110 other nonzero persistent outputs; the intact word returns all zero. The eight private-only mutants affect **103–111 persistent outputs**. This is a precise coverage witness, **not an intact-construction defect or a claim that full production admission accepts mutants**. A caller that guarantees zero incoming centers uses a restricted contract.

Only `research/r480-private-center-adjoint80/` is added. A code-disjoint reverse-mode rational implementation checks both full maps and every omission. Each defect also receives an exact prefix/suffix factorization `Delta = u v^T` and direct basis-vector execution. A separate forward integer-dyadic implementation recomputes **all 42 complete matrices** and checks every factor, witness, classification and site. The full maps erase private coordinates; inverse transposition applies to their 704-coordinate persistent blocks.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/r480-private-center-adjoint80/check.py
python3 -I -O -B research/r480-private-center-adjoint80/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R480_PRIVATE_CENTER_PACKAGE coordinates=712 matrices=42 omissions=40 private_only=8 no_new_kappa`, then four tests pass.

Validation passed on Linux / CPython 3.12.3: two exact matrix engines, 32 nonzero omission witnesses, all eight private-only unit inputs, singular COPY/CLEAR laws, 2,000 arithmetic comparisons, optimized minimal offline relocation, forged-rank/factor/site/orientation controls, and archive corruption. `make selected-record-check`, 25 selected-record regressions and whitespace checks pass.

Exact base: **c0e3631dc24e3c24a861f7d3d79e0608481cccec**. OS seed **80**, independent-verification track. Selection at the base: PR1094, conditional kappa `836330098538459/500000000000000000`. The actual source is `slots/local/LOCAL-PROGRAMS.json.gz` inside `research/community-frontier1042-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz`, archive SHA256 `22c3f4dce4b897a1d423d1388801933e288b6a6b1906cb15e1b16a5eb68db754`. The historical R492 evidence is not used. Source pins bind three repository inputs, four archive members and the frozen selected context. All repository inputs still match refreshed main `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`.

Credit **Sagar Thakrar / PR745** for the historical JP8 adjoint/private-input precedent. This adds the actual R480 object, all 40 omissions, all eight private-only response vectors, and exact rank-one prefix/suffix factors. Credit Ryan Haines / PR835's distinct modular SW4 audit and the **Jeremy Kothe / Rohan Arun / Hao Yan / Chafik Boukhalfa / icekylinx / DreamingOfClouds / eumemic** construction lineage. The overlap refresh through **PR1184** found distinct paid cleanup COPY transposition in **PR1174** and preserved 704-column native-auditor acceleration in **PR1184**. Both exclude this complete private-center fault atlas. No predecessor code or pending patch is imported.

Scope: literal scalar macro projection and single private-center CLEAR/COPY omissions. Non-scalar/native frame/Clifford/phase execution, coefficient-work lowering, hosting/invoice/outer assembly, precision/tape and all-size/analytic obligations remain unexecuted and inherited. The finite matrices do not formally prove the multiplication theorem. Paid profiles, the selected frontier and `upstream/` remain unchanged.

Contribution through **@Scratch-net with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, implementation, proof, verification and writing. Both implementations are AI-assisted, not independent human review. Apache-2.0; original sources and licenses remain unchanged. The local claim records selection, complete coverage and the stopping rule.
